english.title: Fail to afford street authority reasonable facilities
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an undertaker executing street works at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed to afford **(..SPECIFY STREET AUTHORITY..), the street authority, reasonable facilities for ascertaining whether you were complying with your duties under Part III of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 68(2) of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991.
